model_ui.explanation: One counted prepared-trim observation interval, then airborne entropy optimization with explicitly counted PID fallback and landing support. The predictor does not model skid contact. Integral of modeled physical entropy generation plus terminal motor-cooldown entropy and stored-wake relaxation; no tracking-error cost The clearance guard selects the landing handover; the measured settling state at that instant is reported separately.
model_ui.model_status: Thermodynamic electric reference helicopter · Simulated plant mass 2.000 kg · Simulated plant inertia [0.0600, 0.0950, 0.0900] kg·m². State at state.time; applied solution is preceding integration step; optimizer diagnostics timestamp the last 10 Hz control decision. Power/entropy in thermodynamics are instantaneous at the current state.
model_ui.limitations: Explicitly parameterized simulated vehicle; no measured calibration or hardware validation. Near-hover governed-speed rotors; no detailed stall, ground effect, governor transient or battery electrochemistry. Privileged simulator state and current-wind persistence forecast; no state estimator. NMPC optimizes airborne free flight. Ground approach/contact uses explicit PID landing support; this is not contact-optimal control. Solver rejection also causes counted PID fallback. Finite-budget local optimization; feasibility, convergence, and demonstrated savings are separate claims.
model_ui.estimator_status: Online estimate from accepted causal samples. Simulated plant mass is displayed separately as a diagnostic reference.
model_ui.method: Accumulated least squares: F = m * (dv/dt + g e_z); m = sum(q dot F) / sum(q dot q)
model_ui.signals: Previous airborne velocity increments and rotor/drag force evaluated from observed state; no true plant mass input
model_ui.inertia_assumption: Inertia uses the identified mass scale times nominal inertia; common scaling is assumed, not independently identified
model_ui.sharing: The same estimate is supplied to the PID baseline, PID fallback/landing support, and NMPC predictor/seeds
model_ui.optimizer_status: No optimization was attempted in this planned PID landing interval. Ground contact is outside the free-flight NMPC predictor. NMPC participation uses all control intervals, including initial observation, planned landing support and rejected-solve fallback.
